speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are late, and you smell of fog. There is one candle on the stair-table. I am not lighting a second.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One candle is the work. I am going up, and I am going to sit. I will not walk it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The boards tell on you when you walk. I am not asking what the play is. I am asking you not to wear out the ceiling.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. I was not at this last night. Tonight I am, and I am seated.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then sit. I will not come up to learn if it is finished. If you know that, you may say so in the morning, and not through the plaster.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not say it is finished. I do not know that yet.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is in the chamber. If he is on a book I will not move him. He shifts when the candle is the warm thing.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leave the cat. Supper is below if you want it after, at the same threepence. I am not keeping it hot for a verse.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then I will not sand a fresh leaf. What you need is already on the board.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Go up. Quietly. The house has had fog enough without a pacing overhead.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Quietly. One candle. That is the bargain.
